item.tib: pad 'byung bsang brngan gyis khrus bsang dang mngon rtogs
item.coloph: de ltar bsang brngan bsam 'grub yid bzhin nor bu 'di yi lo rgyus bca' gzhi'i rim pa lag len du dril ba ni/ las 'di yi lo rgyus dang bca' gzhi ni logs su gsal lo gsungs pas/ de'i rten rdzas lag len gsal bar btab pa ni/ sgrub gshen bar chad sel zhing bsam don 'grub pa'i phyir/ sprul pa'i sku mchog blo ldan snying po'i rjes 'breng*/ 'gru rigs kyis btsun pa shes rab ming can (gyis) sbyar ba'o/ 'gro ba'i dpal gyur bsam pa'i don 'grub shog bkra shis bde legs phun tshogs dngos grub rtsol//
